description: Capability "development-vessel:mitosis-tick" fails systematically with zero tasks (0/0) across 40 recent traces, resulting in a cascading failure. The gap reflects an empty task list and missing failure_mode classification, preventing any execution progress and blocking learning. It requires validation in ribosome-extract to detect empty task lists, set appropriate failure_mode, and implement a detect-chain-truncation activity to correlate trace and template task counts.
